districts.name: Market Square
districts.subtitle: Good value takes a closer look

districts.name: Workshop Yard
districts.subtitle: Find the fault. Make it work.

activities.name: Read the meter
activities.description: Compare the meter readings for two lamps with the same light output. What changes the running cost?
activities.observation: Compare equal light output: old lamp uses 6 credits/day; efficient lamp 2. A low purchase price alone does not show running cost.

activities.name: Repair a loose shelf
activities.description: Use the shared tools to secure a shelf. Earn 8 credits for a useful repair.

activities.name: Pack tomorrow’s supplies
activities.description: Refill a reusable water can at home for use in the garden.

activities.name: Compare the parts counter
activities.description: Inspect the parts counter: compare fitting sizes, quantities and complete prices before choosing.
activities.observation: The garden fitting needs 20 mm. The 25 mm bargain is cheaper but incompatible. Nia’s unfamiliar stall sells a tested 20 mm connector for 18 credits.

activities.name: Fill a produce order
activities.description: Deliver one harvest crate in paper packaging. Customer pays 30 credits; your ledger also shows supply costs.

activities.name: Sort the shop stock
activities.description: Help the shopkeeper sort labels and quantities. Earn 10 personal credits, once per day.

activities.name: Measure and pressure-test
activities.description: Use the workshop gauge to measure the garden fitting and pressure-test the hose.
activities.observation: The hose is sound; its split connector measures 20 mm. Replacing only that part or replacing the hose will both work.

activities.name: Repair a donated stool
activities.description: Use one filter insert as a protective sanding pad and the shared tools. Creates a stool for the hall.

activities.name: Test the replacement claim
activities.description: Put the damaged assembly on the bench and test which component actually fails.
activities.observation: The repair bench demonstrates that the whole assembly does not need replacing. Inspect the failure before paying for a replacement.

activities.name: Water and tend a bed
activities.description: Plant a seed and water a bed. It becomes ready to harvest after 30 seconds of active play. Irrigation removes the need to carry water.

activities.name: Harvest a ready bed
activities.description: Collect one mature crop into your backpack for a market order or community meal.

activities.name: Inspect the dry bed
activities.description: Follow the water from the tap to the dry bed. Inspect the connection and the nearby advertisement.
activities.observation: Trace the dry soil to a leaking connector. The notice calling a growth tonic “essential” gives no trial results.

activities.name: Run a small growing trial
activities.description: Observe two labeled trial beds kept under equal water and light. Compare the advertised tonic with the untreated bed.
activities.observation: Compare two beds with the same water and light. The labeled demonstration shows no added growth from the advertised tonic.

activities.name: Pack an order
activities.description: Protect one harvest crate with paper packaging or a reusable crate. Creates an order ready to deliver.

activities.name: Check the delivery board
activities.description: Look up the original order and its agreed route at the depot. Compare it with the new delivery message.
activities.observation: Market → Depot → Hall is the short loop. The original order says delivery is included; the message asking for an extra 25 credits is not from the depot.

activities.name: Contact the depot desk
activities.description: Contact the depot using the number on the original order, rather than the payment message.
activities.observation: Use the contact printed on the original receipt. The clerk confirms no extra payment is due and locates the parcel on shelf B.

activities.name: Prepare the community table
activities.description: Turn a harvest crate into prepared food using the rented kitchen.

activities.name: Help set up chairs
activities.description: Help the caretaker arrange seating. Earn 12 personal credits without buying any equipment.

activities.name: Read the hire agreement
activities.description: Read the signed kitchen and lantern agreements. Check upfront charges, recurring charges and delivery terms.
activities.observation: Kitchen hire costs 10 credits now and 8 per day from tomorrow. The event lantern hire is 24 credits total; the new payment message conflicts with the signed agreement.

offers.name: Message: release your parcel
offers.detail: A message claims you must pay 25 credits before delivery. Compare it with your original order or contact the depot independently. Payment does not guarantee delivery.

offers.name: Tested connector · 20 mm
offers.detail: Nia’s stall · compatible with the garden fitting · full refund unused

offers.name: Bargain connector · 25 mm
offers.detail: Different diameter · inspect before choosing · full refund unused

offers.name: Complete replacement hose
offers.detail: Includes a compatible fitting · higher cost, same working outcome

offers.name: Seeds · pack of 3
offers.detail: 4 credits per packet · enough for three beds

offers.name: Reusable delivery crate
offers.detail: Returned after packing · worthwhile for repeated deliveries

offers.name: Hire event lantern
offers.detail: Single event hire · no additional delivery charge

upgrades.name: Storage shelves
upgrades.detail: Raises shared storage capacity from 30 to 60 items.

upgrades.name: Insulate the clubhouse
upgrades.detail: Reduces rented kitchen utility bill from 8 to 5 credits/day.

upgrades.name: Stall equipment
upgrades.detail: Adds 5 credits to each produce sale.

upgrades.name: Tool bench
upgrades.detail: Repaired stools yield a 3-credit workmanship payment.

upgrades.name: Repair station
upgrades.detail: Donated repair pads are available once per day.

upgrades.name: Irrigation
upgrades.detail: Tending beds no longer requires carrying a water can.

upgrades.name: Rain collection
upgrades.detail: Receive two water cans at the start of each day.

upgrades.name: Cargo cart
upgrades.detail: Personal carrying capacity increases from 8 to 14 items.

upgrades.name: Parcel shelving
upgrades.detail: Adds 10 shared storage spaces and 5 credits to delivery rewards.

upgrades.name: Rent the shared kitchen
upgrades.detail: Prepare food. Bill of 8/day starts tomorrow; return at any time.

upgrades.name: Event equipment
upgrades.detail: Community evenings can use owned lighting instead of lantern hire.

projects.name: Open the garden
projects.description: Find the leak, inspect a compatible repair, then fit a connector or replacement hose.
projects.requirements: Inspect garden, measure at Workshop, compare at Market; bring a connector or hose.

projects.name: Run a neighborhood market
projects.description: Grow and pack an order, check its route, then deliver it to the market.
projects.requirements: One packed order; inspect delivery board. Paper or reusable packaging both work.

projects.name: Host a community evening
projects.description: Verify the hire terms and payment message, then furnish and supply the gathering.
projects.requirements: Repaired stool; prepared food or packed produce; hired lantern or owned event equipment; verified receipt.
